title: Book Three · Chapter 25: The Winter Reply
story:
Another week passes before Leo's next reply arrives.

Ronan finds it on the table after school. Mum is out with a customer. Mrs Lan tells him she brought the letter in from the door.

“Thank you,” he says.

He puts water in the kettle, then sits near the window. The first two letters are in his drawer. This is Leo's third reply.

There is no drawing at the top this time. Leo starts with Kai.

Dear Ronan,

Can he fix my school bag? One corner is coming apart. My aunt says she can sew it. I think she wants me to empty it first.

Ronan looks at his own bag. A corner of old paper shows through the opening.

He reads on.

I told my friend about your paper tray. He made one for his pencil. It was too short. Now he has a tray for half a pencil.

Then Leo writes about the winter holiday.

We are staying here. My aunt's sister will visit. I want to show her the new school from the outside. My aunt says the bus will be less crowded during the holiday.

Ronan puts the page down for a moment.

He did not ask Leo to come back. Still, he had pictured a walk along West Lane. In his mind, Leo had the same bag and the same loud laugh.

Outside, a cart moves past the gate. Ronan can hear Mr Qiu talking to someone about pencils.

He picks up the letter again.

Leo wants to know more about the football game. At the bottom, he adds one question.

Did the wind ever lose?

Ronan smiles. In his third letter, he told Leo about the missed kick too. Leo has found the part he hoped to forget.

Mum comes home as the kettle begins to make a sound. She takes it off the stove and puts her bag down.

“New letter?”

“Yes. He is staying there for the holiday.”

She nods. “That is a long trip for a short visit.”

“I know.”

“Would you like some tea?”

Ronan gets two cups. Mum looks at the loose paper in his bag.

“I would like a clear table too.”

He empties the bag beside his chair. There are three old sheets, a pencil with no point, and a leaf in small pieces.

“A tree,” Mum says.

“Only a little one.”

He puts the rubbish in the bin. He keeps two clean sheets and the pencil. Then he makes room for the cups.

After tea, he reads Leo's letter once more. He folds it and puts it beside the other two.

He takes one clean sheet to the table. At the top, he writes a question about Leo's winter visitors. Then he sharpens the old pencil for his school work.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

come apart＝开裂、散开；crowded＝拥挤的；picture＝在脑中想象（本章作动词）；rubbish＝垃圾。

## 理解问题

1. Leo冬假准备在哪里过？Ronan为什么读到这里停了一会儿？
2. 这封信是Leo第几次回信？Ronan当晚有没有把下一封信写完寄出？

## 读句子

**He puts the rubbish in the bin.**

拆开看：He / puts the rubbish / in the bin.

他／把垃圾放好／放进垃圾桶里。
